name: Insanity
overview: Scripture presents insanity both as a divine judgment and as a condition that can be feigned or misunderstood. Deuteronomy 28:28 reveals that madness can be a consequence of God's discipline, while 1 Samuel 21:13-15 illustrates David's deliberate act of feigning madness to protect himself. Proverbs 25:28 highlights the spiritual vulnerability of lacking self-control, likening it to a defenseless city. Together, these verses underscore the seriousness of madness in both physical and spiritual dimensions, affirming God's sovereignty and the human need for self-governance.
